时间、纳入范围与换算方法: Timing, inclusion criteria, and mapping method
每篇论文先对逐条评分求均值，再按该年端点映射；各论文权重相同。无评分记录不作为零: Individual scores are averaged within each paper before applying that year’s endpoint mapping; each paper receives equal weight. Missing scores are not treated as zero, while valid zero scores from 2026 are retained. Only aggregate distributions are included; author and reviewer identities are not redistributed.
不同年份的投稿群体、评审人群、公开覆盖、讨论进度、档位含义和分布离散程度均不同。: Submission cohorts, reviewer populations, public coverage, discussion progress, score-label meanings, and score granularity differ across years. A difference in mapped means therefore does not measure how much the new scoring system lowered scores. Isolating the scale’s effect would require the same papers rated on both scales or credible calibration data.
采集跨越一段时间，讨论期内评分仍可能更新。本页没有终审决定或录用率预测；跨年比较: Collection spans a time interval, and scores may change during discussion. This page provides no final decisions or acceptance predictions. The year comparison uses separate historical initial archives, not changes in scores for the same papers. Differences from other sites may reflect collection time and scope.
